name: Oikawa Marumi
source:
This heroine is a mild-mannered, quiet, little sister type.
She comes from a farming family in the countryside.

She's shy in all things and a bit of a shrewd girl.

She has a slim build.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/soleil/itsudatsu/]official site[/url]]
